Class MM1Logic

java.lang.Object
jmt.jmarkov.Queues.MM1Logic
All Implemented Interfaces:
QueueLogic
Direct Known Subclasses:
MM1dLogic, MMNdLogic, MMNLogic
public class MM1Logic extends Object implements QueueLogic
Contains the algorithm of the queue M/M/1 where lambda represent the arrival of the job in second and s as service time of the job in the processor. M/M/1 is the poisson process of arrival and service time.
